# Golden Bay Technologies (GBTech)

IT support and computer repair based in Tākaka / Golden Bay, with remote coverage across Nelson, Tasman and NZ. Local since 2014 — same-day remote fixes, no ticket queue. Differentiator: systems deployment — owned websites and booking, Microsoft 365, security that keeps small businesses insurable, and custom business software.

Site: https://gbtech.co.nz/
Contact: Warwick Marshall · warwick.marshall@gmail.com · +64 27 814 2222
